name: Mandarin Oriental, Hong Kong
positioning: Five-star urban hotel at 5 Connaught Road Central in Hong Kong, overlooking Victoria Harbour, with direct access to the Star Ferry
best_for: Travelers who want a Central base overlooking Victoria Harbour
Diners who want Cantonese, grill and izakaya restaurants on site

facts.text: The hotel is located at 5 Connaught Road Central, Hong Kong, overlooking Victoria Harbour.
The hotel has direct access to the Star Ferry.
The hotel describes itself as a five-star urban retreat in the heart of the city.
Man Wah is a Michelin-starred restaurant.
Man Wah is located high within the hotel and offers sweeping views across Victoria Harbour and Hong Kong's skyline.
Terrace Boulud by Mandarin Oriental is a rooftop brasserie.
The Aubrey is a Japanese izakaya.
Room categories include City View, Statue Square View and Harbour View Rooms.

highlights.text: Harbour View Rooms offer views of Victoria Harbour.
Clipper Lounge is an international buffet restaurant.
The Krug Room offers creative tasting menus partnered with Krug champagne.

considerations.text: Mandarin Oriental, Hong Kong is in the next phase of its transformation.
Spa and wellness experiences are currently available at Mandarin Oriental The Landmark, Hong Kong.
WhataHotel notes the busy Central District location can be crowded.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
